newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Canberra says rabbit virus now Australia-wide.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Canberra says rabbit virus now Australia-wide.

text.p: Australian Primary Industries Minister John Anderson said on Tuesday the virus designed to cut the country's pest rabbit population had spread throughout Australia.
"Rabbit calicivirus is now present in all states and territories, following deliberate release at 350 sites in all mainland states and territories," Anderson said in a statement.
He said the spread of the disease had been patchy in some areas, but cooler autumn temperatures would now enable agencies to release the virus at more sites.
The virus was first released in New South Wales state last October.

Farmers blame rabbits -- descended from animals imported by a British hunting enthusiast in the 19th century -- for causing hundreds of millions of dollars of damage to crops and driving native animals and plants to the verge of extinction.
